WITH store_sales_year AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_customer_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_customer_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_customer_email AS customer_email,
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(s.s_store_sales) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN store_sales s ON c.c_customer_id = s.s_customer_id
    JOIN date_dim d ON s.s_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c.c_customer_id, 
        c.c_customer_first_name, 
        c.c_customer_last_name, 
        c.c_customer_email, 
        d.d_year
    HAVING 
        d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
        AND SUM(s.s_store_sales) > 0
),
web_sales_year AS (
    SELECT 
        c.c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c.c_customer_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c.c_customer_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c.c_customer_email AS customer_email,
        d.d_year AS year,
        SUM(w.w_web_sales) AS year_total
    FROM customer c
    JOIN web_sales w ON c.c_customer_id = w.w_customer_id
    JOIN date_dim d ON w.w_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY 
        c.c_customer_id, 
        c.c_customer_first_name, 
        c.c_customer_last_name, 
        c.c_customer_email, 
        d.d_year
    HAVING 
        d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
        AND SUM(w.w_web_sales) > 0
)
SELECT 
    s1.customer_id,
    s1.customer_first_name,
    s1.customer_last_name,
    s1.customer_email
FROM store_sales_year s1
JOIN store_sales_year s2 ON s1.customer_id = s2.customer_id
JOIN web_sales_year w1 ON s1.customer_id = w1.customer_id
JOIN web_sales_year w2 ON s1.customer_id = w2.customer_id
WHERE 
    s1.year = 1998
    AND s2.year = 1999
    AND w1.year = 1998
    AND w2.year = 1999
    AND (w2.year_total / w1.year_total) > 1.1
    AND (s2.year_total / s1.year_total) > 1.1
ORDER BY s1.customer_id
LIMIT 100
